post.text:
Donut Labs from Finland have just announced the first Solid State Battery that is commercially available!

Made to last 100.000 cycles, and uses abundant, affordable, and geopolitically safe materials. 

Europe is building the NXT generation of technology 🇪🇺 https://t.co/YGaPiPHhRq
post.author_description: Building the Pan-European movement for progress. Together we can build the NXT generation of politics.

description.description: An infographic comparing the charge cycles of different battery types using a bar chart on a dark background. It lists 'Typical Lithium-ion' at 1000-1500 cycles with a very short bar, 'High-end Lithium-ion' at 5000 cycles with a slightly longer bar, and 'Donut Battery' at 100,000 cycles with a significantly longer bar.
description.ocrText: Typical Lithium-ion 1000-1500 cycles High-end Lithium-ion 5000 cycles Donut Battery 100,000 cycles
